mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id as userId, u.email, u.nickname, u.introduction, u.phone_number as phoneNumber, u.gender, u.profile_img as profileImg, u.created_at as createdAt, ua.address as address, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE seller_id = u.user_id) as sellingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE buyer_id = u.user_id) as boughtCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_favorites WHERE user_id = u.user_id) as favoriteCount FROM users u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, address FROM user_address WHERE is_default = 1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) ua ON u.user_id = ua.user_id WHERE u.email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address ( user_id, address, address_name, receiver_name, receiver_phone, zip_code, is_default, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{address}, '기본배송지', '사용자', '010-0000-0000', '00000', 1, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE address = VALUES(address), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT password FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET profile_img = #{profileImg} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM products WHERE seller_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT p.*, u.nickname as seller_nickname, u.profile_img as seller_profile_img FROM products p JOIN users u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE p.buyer_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.*, u.nickname as seller_nickname, u.profile_img as seller_profile_img FROM user_favorites f JOIN products p ON f.product_id = p.product_id JOIN users u ON p.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id as reviewId, r.content, r.rating, r.created_at as createdAt, p.product_id as productId, p.product_name as productName, p.main_image_url as productImageUrl, p.region_display_name as regionDisplayName, -- 지역 추가 u.nickname as writerNickname, u.profile_img as writerProfileImg, 'RECEIVED' as type FROM reviews r JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id JOIN users u ON r.buyer_id = u.user_id WHERE r.seller_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
